description.p: TMPlayer plays the videos in your own Telegram chats and channels. It starts within seconds while the file is still downloading, and seeking re-aims the download instead of waiting for it.

ul.li: Sign in with a QR code or your phone number
Browse the videos in every chat as a poster grid, with what you were watching first
Resume where you stopped, and go on to the next episode
Embedded subtitles and audio tracks, drawn by libmpv
Full keyboard and mouse control, media keys and MPRIS

description.p: TMPlayer is an unofficial client. It is not made by or affiliated with Telegram.
